item_short_desc: Rothco's Triple Retention Buckle is expertly crafted to provide superior security and reliability, modeled after our best-selling Deluxe Duty Belt. This 2-inch buckle features a triple retention system, including a side and center push button release, ensuring a secure hold while allowing for quick and easy access when needed. Designed to fit belts up to 2 inches wide, making it ideal for law enforcement, security personnel, and tactical enthusiasts who require gear they can trust.
